headline: Drake Maye delivers clutch win over Bills in western New York
morning_brew: I watched that game through my fingers like a horror movie, but we finally got one in the win column. Beating the Bills twenty-nine to twenty-six on the road is exactly the kind of gritty performance this team needed after a sluggish start. Drake Maye looked like he belonged out there, carving them up with three touchdown passes and adding some life with his legs when the pocket started to collapse. It wasn't perfect, and that second quarter had me pacing the kitchen and yelling at the toaster, but for once, the breaks finally swung our way.

The defense had their hands full with Buffalo all afternoon, but they stepped up when the game was on the line. I know C.J. Gardner-Johnson wants to talk about luck, but when you make plays like Efton Chism III did, you create your own breaks. We are sitting at two and two now, and while the road ahead is a gauntlet, Sunday's result feels like a massive weight off our shoulders. I haven't seen a win that felt this necessary since my pops took me to my first game, grabbed my shoulder, and told me to never count us out.

Looking ahead, the Bruins are back at the Garden tonight for a date with Ottawa. First puck drop is at seven-thirty, and after that rough outing in Minnesota, I am looking for a completely different energy on home ice. The Senators are coming in off a win, but we need to establish our presence in the Atlantic right out of the gate. I will be glued to the screen tonight, hoping for a clean performance and a much-needed bounce back to get a small deposit back into the Duck Boat fund.

news_digest.headline: C.J. Gardner-Johnson: Efton Chism III is a 'practice squad player' who 'made a hell of a catch'
news_digest.dans_take: Talk is cheap, and the scoreboard doesn't care about your depth chart labels.

news_digest.headline: Senators visit the Bruins in Atlantic Division action
news_digest.dans_take: A prime opportunity to get right at the Garden after a brutal weekend away.

trend_watch.trend: Completed twenty-two of thirty-seven passes for two hundred sixty-nine yards and three touchdowns while adding fifty-four yards on the ground.
trend_watch.dans_take: He played like a guy who doesn't know what nerves are, and frankly, I need him to keep that same energy.

trend_watch.trend: The unit paved the way for a balanced attack that kept the Bills defense guessing all game.
trend_watch.dans_take: They finally gave Maye some room to breathe, and seeing that pocket hold up felt like a miracle.

trend_watch.trend: Reeled in five catches for sixty-two yards to lead all Patriots receivers in production.
trend_watch.dans_take: He is the reliable safety blanket we need when the sticks are moving and the clock is winding down.
